design.purpose: A drained outdoor planter for herbs or flowers for one person, using all three weathered boards. Interior is about 40 × 14 × 15 cm, so fill with about 8 litres of compost to 2 cm below the rim.

steps.c: Place the 18 cm-wide board flat for cutting
Cut a 44 cm base; keep the 75.7 cm offcut
Place the 15 cm-wide board flat for cutting
Cut 44, 44, 14 and 14 cm planter sides
Place the 20 cm-wide board flat for cutting
Cut two 18 cm feet; keep the offcut
Sand all cut edges of the seven planter parts
Place the 44 × 18 cm base flat
Drill three drainage holes through the base
Stand the 44 cm front on the base front edge
Stand the 44 cm back on the base back edge
Fit the 14 cm left end between the sides
Fit the 14 cm right end between the sides
Turn the first foot crosswise under the base
Turn the second foot crosswise under the base
Drive screws through the front into the left end
Drive screws through the front into the right end
Drive screws through the back into the left end
Drive screws through the back into the right end
Drive screws upward through base into front
Drive screws upward through base into back
Drive screws upward through base into left end
Drive screws upward through base into right end
Drive screws upward through first foot into base
Drive screws upward through second foot into base
